rows.label: Inside a small glass cabinet, glasses with initials written on them stay untouched.
A painting in a heavy wooden frame hangs from a distant metal hook by one long cord.
Outside, well-kept trees surround the building.
Enormous windows offer a privileged view of the city.
Oddly shaped chairs surround a small round table.
An elegant magazine rack sits close to a tall plant, full of travel magazines.
A minimalistic wall light casts cones of shadow around it.
Flowers with a citric smell sit inside a brass jar.
Light reflects on the doorframes, accentuating their curved relief.
Purple flowers rest in a glass vase with a geometric design.
One wall is covered with bright, irregular bricks.
The lights shine on a flawless marble floor.
Dried twigs sprout out of a ceramic vase on a very short end table.
Every door handle is sinuous, spotless, and golden.
A wooden chair in the shape of a human hand occupies a small corner.
On the ceiling, geometric shapes form a chandelier that looks like a modern sculpture.
A rustic wooden bench rests near the wall, a bell sitting on the rough surface of the seat.
Enormous curtains fall from above and are held by stone columns, reminiscent of a palace.
Arabesques cover the seat of an armchair and the small cushions resting on it.
The ceiling is covered by sinuous wooden shapes, perfectly polished.
A gigantic glass chandelier hangs from the ceiling by a thick metal pole.
A high-end security camera watches everything from a vantage point.
Enormous stone pillars hold the ceiling above a gleaming floor.
A bas-relief artwork in stone covers an entire wall.
All the windows have the same complex, asymmetrical wooden frame.
The curves of a statuette shine under a table lamp, showered in warm light.
A thick, square photography book rests beside a metal statuette.
A large round mirror hangs in the middle of the wall; another, smaller one, covers part of it.
Golden geometric patterns on the walls reflect every light.
A minimalistic wooden statuette representing an exotic animal stands on a shelf.
Shards of fading vibrant light shine inside a tall geode on the floor.
Large-scale floral patterns cover an enormous carpet on the ground.
Two symmetrical marble slabs form a colossal square on the wall.
A shiny black suitcase rests against a chair.
An original Renaissance painting is framed in glass within a frame that might be as old as the painting.
Tiny vivid-colored flowers cover the crown of a massive bonsai.
Colored, reflective polygons give shape to an abstract sculpture.
On the walls, larger pilasters above alternate with others below.
Tree slices form the tops of a few stools and the table they gather around.
Two pieces of metal fit together to form a table resembling a yin-yang shape.
Two tall, old-looking urns stand side by side, covered in contrasting but matching patterns and colors.
An elegant coffee machine exhales a refined aroma beside a tray of cups.
The soft colors of heavy drapes and a wool carpet harmonize with each other.
Thick walls provide a haven of silence within this noisy city.
A subtle scent of firewood is exhaled by a minimalist fireplace embedded in the wall.
A turned-off metal desk lamp hangs from the ceiling over an autograph book.
Doors, windows, chairs, desks, tables… everything is elegant, every surface clean.
A latest-generation iPad charges on a USB socket embedded in the wall.
A sleek VR headset rests on a corner table.
A large metal frame holds a small painting on the wall. It’s the original of a famous painter.
